body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids math printable: Math Practice 15.
Short, friendly maths practice with pictures to help — add, subtract and solve one problem at a time, showing your thinking in the box.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet and work down the problems. Using fingers, drawings or counters to help is not cheating — it is exactly how mathematicians start.

takeaway: Little and often wins: five minutes of cheerful maths practice beats an hour of struggle.
materials: Counters, coins or pasta pieces for working out
supervision: Stay close enough to celebrate strategies, not just answers — "you counted back on your fingers, clever" builds a mathematician.
safetyNotes: If you use small counters or coins, keep them away from children under 3 — they are a choking hazard.
Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Make up one more problem together using snacks or toys — eat the answer when you solve it.
